method: Retained affine sheet frame with 75 preserved street and monument anchors and a regularized inverse thin-plate spline. Fixed boundaries and thirty-two withheld checks; manual annotations, not a survey.
rights: Archives municipales de Toulouse, 20 Fi 66. Domaine public, stated in official Flickr description. Justin Jourdan; Prosper Riviere.

annotationNotes: Street-axis intersections, canal bridge centres and preserved monuments inspected on original scans against IGN PLANIGNV2. Excludes new street cuts and the projected Amidonniers bridge. Chateau d eau annotations corrected to the actual circular tower. Check points never participate in fitting. Capitole check refined to the centre of the open square, excluding facade and corner; four adjacent street-axis anchors added. Quarter survey: Dalbade, Taur, Royal garden, Grand Rond, Saint-Cyprien. Fifteen withheld landmarks. Paul-Sabatier and De-la-Bastide checks refined to actual road centrelines; comparisons use these identical revised annotations in both versions. Modern road coordinates cross-checked with OpenStreetMap nodes (2026-10-01); historical topology checked before matching. Tour-du-Sac through-junction excluded; retained junction on Rue de la Laque is withheld. 2026-10-02: local survey of Parlement / former Carmelites, Brienne / Bazacle and Saint-Aubin. Eleven additional fitting junctions and five withheld checks. Corrected the Riquet / Colombette misidentification. Modern divided-road or cycleway nodes are not interchangeable with historical street axes. Comparison uses the frozen preceding 40-anchor field on identical observations. Northeast refinement: corrected Bayard and Matabiau bridge positions, six additional fitting openings and three withheld checks around Jean-Jaures, Bayard and Place Belfort. Later Rue Lafon and Bertrand-de-Born cuts excluded. Minimes: corrected a source annotation east of the bridge to the actual crossing [637.5,174.5]; retained modern centre and adjoining street topology. Arnaud-Bernard: corrected Lascrosses boulevard misidentification and added five preserved fitting junctions and three withheld checks northwest of Saint-Sernin. Saint-Julien / Peyrou: four fitting junctions and two withheld checks constrain the southern continuation of the Arnaud-Bernard quarter, including Embarthe, Salenques, Chaine and Puits-Creuses. Strasbourg: five preserved fitting openings and three withheld checks around Saint-Bernard, Bellegarde, Remusat and western Bayard. Saint-Loup / Moutons correspondence resolves the previously misidentified western Bayard candidate. Terre-Cabade: main gateway, southwest corner and two approach junctions fitted; Saint-Paul approach withheld. Northern extensions and the unverified central monument symbol are not matched.

excludedLandmarks.name: Teinturiers / Tour-du-Sac axis
excludedLandmarks.reason: The modern through-junction is absent on the 1904 sheet: Rue du Tour du Sac ends before Rue des Teinturiers. Excluded consistently from all three comparisons.

excludedLandmarks.name: Colombette / Amelie and Mercadier axes
excludedLandmarks.reason: Neither modern north-south street is drawn through the plot north of Saint-Aubin on this sheet. Use the preserved canal bridge abutment instead; do not force later street cuts onto the 1860 plan.

excludedLandmarks.name: Sabots / Feuga axis
excludedLandmarks.reason: Rejected during local validation: the old street opens onto the irregular Place Saint-Michel, whereas the modern node meets the through-road axis of Allee Paul Feuga. The scan has no matching through-road intersection there. Trial errors were 11.3 m before and 37.0 m after; not used in fitting or the final independent accuracy summary.

excludedLandmarks.name: Bayard / Strasbourg axis
excludedLandmarks.reason: Exploratory northeast annotation rejected: the source labels projected streets below the Redoutes junction and the correspondence with the later widened western Bayard alignment is ambiguous. Not a reliable preserved intersection. Exploratory withheld Jacques-Laffitte error was 85.1 m. Keep this limitation visible rather than force the western street topology. Subsequently resolved as the northeast street opening, paired with former Saint-Loup / Moutons; fitted under a precise new name.

excludedLandmarks.name: Bayard / Jacques Laffitte axis
excludedLandmarks.reason: Exploratory northeast annotation rejected: the source labels projected streets below the Redoutes junction and the correspondence with the later widened western Bayard alignment is ambiguous. Not a reliable preserved intersection. Exploratory withheld Jacques-Laffitte error was 85.1 m. Keep this limitation visible rather than force the western street topology. Subsequently identified as former Saint-Loup / present Moutons, retained as a withheld observation under the corrected name.
